reason: We moved off E-Golf4U less than a year ago, the volunteers are exhausted and members have only just learned the new system. I am not putting another switch to the members' meeting this soon, however well you package it, and certainly not with a company of two people.
objection: Escrow and a monthly export sound good on paper, but if the two of you stop I am the one who has to tell 950 members to find their way back to something else. A third migration in two years would cost me my volunteers and my credibility on the board.
would_change_my_mind: Our current system failing us or raising its price sharply, plus two or three clubs our size, beyond Zwolle, running on it for a full season without trouble.
